text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (Trainer is watching...!)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(Every day, reflecting on the time we've 
spent together... I gave my all to my 
training...!)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(My running... holds everything we shared 
together...!)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(And... even though you shouldn't have 
made it in time, you rushed over. —For my 
sake!)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (We have created... a miraculous drama!!)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(Now that I have the Genesis Factor! I 
will――definitely win!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Chronooo! Give it your aaaaall! Go for 
ittttttt!!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (Together with me, the fans, and Trainer—)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: We will make history with Chrono Genesis!!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaaaaaaahhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: ――In 1st place is Chrono Genesis!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Chrono Genesis conquers the Arima Kinen! 
Following her Takarazuka Kinen victory, 
she achieves back-to-back Grand Prix 
titles!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Haa, hah...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Applause, applause! It's this applause!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...! ...Fufu, it's so warm...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
A celebration of back-to-back Grand Prix 
victories... and your return as Trainer, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I believe you've etched a brilliance that 
belongs to you alone into history, 
Chrono-chan.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I'll be right behind you! So, let's meet 
at the top!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Chrono-san and I—will surely continue to 
clash in many races to come.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I will catch up, so— Let's keep moving 
forward together, okay?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Loves-chan, Bouquet-san... Yes... let us 
meet again up ahead...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Heeey! Don't forget about me! The closest 
one to the top is m-e-e-e!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, oh Gran-chan. That's so like 
you...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I see... Building a generation, huh. I 
feel like I'm startin' to understand a lot 
of things now.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: I've got an idea of who it might be, too.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
In that case, it's me, Lala, and Ai! We'll 
take on Chrono and the others!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I-I'm honored...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone, thank you so very much for 
your warm support...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
No, thank YOU for moving our hearts so 
deeply!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
While Trainer was away... I received so 
many warm words of support. From the 
bottom of my heart, thank you so very 
much...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"The Umamusume, the fans, the Trainer... 
Together, all of them have woven the 
tapestry of history today."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I want to continue... writing history 
together with everyone, moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I want to keep putting on races like 
today's... so that watching them brings a 
smile to everyone's face...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
This sense of unity... It truly is the 
Grand Prix. I feel like basking in it 
forever, but—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Bringing the drama to its conclusion is 
the Trainer's role, you know?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Chrono-chan is waiting for you! Hurry on 
over!"

From deep within the dim underground 
tunnel, the sound of hoofbeats and heavy 
breathing drew closer.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
D-Discharged...! I had no idea you'd 
already left the hospital...!
choice_data_list:
I worked hard at rehab and got a pass to 
come rushing over!

text_block_list.text:
I explain that Gran Alegria was the one 
who brought me over when my footing was 
unsteady, and that the rest of their 
generation helped out as well.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
S-So that's what happened... I need to 
thank everyone, too...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, excuse me... I heard you haven't 
been discharged yet, but..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
St... Starting today, to visit you... 
C-Can I... stay by your side...?
choice_data_list:
Yeah. Looking forward to working with you 
again, Chrono!

Yeah. Looking forward to working with you 
again, Chrono!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Yes...! Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: A Certain History Column
text_block_list.text:
"—Her running was more powerful than 
anyone else's. There was not a shred of 
hesitation in any of her strides."

text_block_list.name: A Certain History Column
text_block_list.text:
Believing in her strength. Believing in 
the days we've built together, and the 
bond we share.

text_block_list.name: A Certain History Column
text_block_list.text: One day, I too—a wish surged in my chest.

text_block_list.name: A Certain History Column
text_block_list.text:
Hand in hand with those who believe, I 
wish to aim for it—the first-magnitude 
star shining atop our generation.

text_block_list.name: A Certain History Column
text_block_list.text:
...And so, history connects forward. Not a 
single hoofprint is without meaning; every 
last one shapes the racing history yet to 
come.
